note_en: 哪怕 means "even if" and is usually answered by 也 in the main clause: 哪怕收入不高，很多主播也舍不得停播 "even if their income is low, many streamers still can't bear to stop." Unlike English "even if," the Chinese needs that second marker 也 ("still, all the same") to close the pattern, and 哪怕 sounds more emphatic than plain 即使.
